# 🐢 Turtle Client - A Minecraft Java Client 

**A lightweight and customizable Minecraft Java client focused on utility, visuals, clean UI, and performance improvements.**

![Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d95a68c5f32f34cb7b357f9e4b2fc1868ca4adc.png)

«Note: The name of this project was inspired by a Minecraft Bedrock client.»

Their licence: https://github.com/TurtleUtilityPack/turtle-client

---

# ✨ Features

Turtle Client includes various built-in features and HUD modules designed to improve gameplay and customization.

Included Features

- FPS Counter
- CPS Counter
- Coordinates HUD
- FullBright
- Freelook
- Combo Counter
- Clock
- Direction HUD
- Armor Status
- Attack Indicator
- Block Overlay
- Chat Improvements
- Discord RPC
- Custom Crosshair
- HUD Customization
- Perspective Toggle
- UI Customization
- Animation Tweaks

---

# 🤔 Why Turtle Client?

Turtle Client is designed for players who want:

- A clean and modern interface
- Useful built-in modules
- Lightweight gameplay enhancements
- Easy customization
- Better visual experience

The client focuses on simplicity while still providing useful features for everyday gameplay.

---

# 📥 Installation

## 💻 PC

1. Download the TurtleClient-x.x.x.jar file
2. Place the file inside your Minecraft mods folder
3. Launch the game using Fabric Loader

## 📲 Android / Mobile Java Launchers

1. Download the TurtleClient-x.x.x.jar file
2. Place the file inside your mods folder
3. Launch Minecraft using your preferred Java launcher

---

# 💥 Compatibility

## ✔️ Supported

- Fabric

## ❌ Not Supported

- Forge
- NeoForge
- Feather Client
- Lunar Client
- Some custom Minecraft clients may be incompatible
